inputs.rationale: The feature is a structural extension to the WebAssembly module format and a declarative JS instantiation option, rather than a callable procedural API with runtime inputs.

outputs.rationale: The feature is a structural extension and declarative option, producing prototype chains on Wasm objects inherently, rather than a procedural API returning a value.

errors.rationale: The feature documentation covers declarative structure and prototype chain wiring. Validation errors occur at compile time based on standard WebAssembly type-checking rules not specific to runtime exception flows documented here.

lifecycle.rationale: The feature is an engine-managed structural type mechanism that integrates with JS garbage collection directly; there is no explicit developer-facing programmatic lifecycle or teardown surface.

securityPrivacy.rationale: The feature defines purely in-engine structural types and JS prototype wiring. It does not introduce new privileges, cross-origin access, or privacy surface.
